items.title: A Formal Model for Leased Work Queues

claims.statement: The model separates claim ownership, lease expiry, heartbeat, completion, and retry transitions.
The safety argument rejects stale completion after a newer fencing token is issued.

interpretation: The state variables align closely with the coordinator lease protocol and can inform model-based regression tests.
uncertainty: The preprint has not yet established production behavior under every database isolation level.
proposed_experiments: Translate the transition system into a bounded property test for stale completion and lease takeover.

items.title: Independent Schema Authorities and Semantic Conformance

claims.statement: Peer-authority conformance compares normalized semantics rather than generated source text.
Lossy mappings require explicit, expiring waivers bound to source and generator versions.

interpretation: The normalization approach is suitable for independent TypeSpec and JSON Schema generation pipelines.
uncertainty: The specification leaves language-specific numeric widening policy to downstream profiles.
proposed_experiments: Run recursive-union and decimal-precision fixtures through both schema pipelines and compare normalized output.

items.title: Bounded Attribute Cardinality for Distributed Tracing

claims.statement: Unbounded user, repository, request, and payload values should not be emitted as metric label dimensions.

interpretation: The guidance supports hashing or event-only storage for high-cardinality correlation identities.
uncertainty: Recommended limits vary with backend pricing and aggregation strategy.
proposed_experiments: Measure current coordinator label cardinality under a synthetic multi-organization workload.

notes: The fixture uses synthetic primary-source records and content-free hashes.
Interpretations and proposed experiments are explicitly separated from source-bound claims.
